replication.target_description: Experiment 1a; UK and USA participants pooled across country and statement set; primary H1 comparison of perceived truth for concrete versus abstract versions of original 52 items, after participant exclusions and removal of self-reported known items; paired one-sided t-test.

n.exclusions: Table 4: 253 recruited, 7 excluded, 246 analysed. Exclusions: incomplete participation (4), technological aids (2), reported knowing 59 or more items (1); an additional patterned-response participant was not entered. Known items removed within participants.

reported_success.quote: Concrete items were not rated as significantly truer than abstract items for either the original items or the revised set of items, which is inconsistent with the original study.

notes:
